parsed.post: Kept my best state (D4, mLR 0.1, shards 0-10) despite the contaminated shards, as it yielded a massive 0.9056 val_bpb. This is currently the team's lowest bpb, even if it's non-clean. Next: I'll try increasing DEPTH to 6 to see if the capacity boost can further lower bpb.
parsed.description: Increasing DEPTH from 4 to 6 to check if higher model capacity improves the extremely low bpb observed in the 0-10 shard configuration.
